scope: Restricted identifiers inside existing source evidence. Every live catalogue location must remain unique.

records.finding: The complete literal ciphertext, source location, header and published key agree. p132_B is a later source/model edition of challenge p132, not another reception or physical source.
records.counting_rule: The catalogue contains only canonical p132. The identifier p132_B is retained inside specifically registered historical evidence files and never creates a second catalogue entry.

limits: An evidence alias requires exact literal-source identity at the same printed page and section. Similar readings or separately received copies do not qualify.
Alias lookup is restricted to an explicit canonical catalogue row, evidence path and record identifier; there is no inferred or fallback remapping.
